name: Falling Shapes
author: Sahan Ranasingha

sections.description:
Falling Shapes is a simple plugin designed for festive occasions or celebrations. It enables you to make shapes (selected images) fall randomly across your website, creating a fun and festive ambiance.

Features:
* Falling animations for shapes (images from Media Library).
* Fully customizable via an admin dashboard.
* Responsive design ensuring compatibility across devices.
* Easily add or remove images via the WordPress Media Library.
sections.faq:
Can I control which shapes fall on the screen?

Yes, you can upload or select images from the Media Library in the plugin’s settings.

Will the animation slow down my site?

The plugin is designed to have minimal impact on site performance.

Can I disable the plugin temporarily?

Yes, you can deactivate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release of the Falling Shapes plugin.

1.1

  • Added premium plugin features for customization of falling shapes (speed, direction, frequency).
  • Added a “Buy Premium” button with a link to support the plugin and unlock advanced options.
  • Updated the admin settings page with a section for premium features and documentation.

1.4

  • Updated compatibility tested up to WordPress 6.9.
